Name: Revenue reporting
Description: Revenue by product and region, refreshed daily from the Gold lakehouse.

Name: Monthly close ledger
Description: General ledger journals for the monthly close, locked after sign-off.

Name: Cost center budgets
Description: Approved budgets by cost center and month.

Name: Revenue forecast
Description: Weekly revenue forecast by region, not yet reviewed by finance planning.

Name: Customer accounts
Description: Golden record for every customer account, merged nightly from the CRM and the order system. It includes the account hierarchy, billing region, industry, segment and account team. Use it for revenue attribution and churn reporting. Don't use it for marketing outreach without a consent check. Request access through the Sales domain.

Name: Order lines
Description: One row per order line, with product, quantity, net amount and ship date.

Name: Pipeline snapshot
Description: Weekly snapshot of open opportunities by stage.

Name: Workforce headcount
Description: Monthly headcount by legal entity, department, location and employment type, taken on the last working day of each month. It holds no pay data. Figures are restated when late hires or exits arrive, so always read the latest snapshot. Access is limited to HR business partners and the finance planning team.

Name: Payroll summary
Description: Gross and net pay totals by legal entity and month, with no individual pay data.

Name: Learning records
Description: Course completions by employee and course.

Name: Campaign performance
Description: Spend, reach and conversions by campaign and channel.

Name: Web sessions
Description: Web sessions from the public website and the online store, one row per session, with landing page, referrer, device type, campaign code and consent state. Sessions without analytics consent are dropped before load, and data older than 25 months is purged. Join on campaign code to attribute sessions to campaigns.

Name: Inventory positions
Description: Stock on hand by warehouse and product at the end of each day.

Name: Supplier master
Description: Approved suppliers with payment terms and risk rating.

Name: Support cases
Description: Support cases with status, priority, product and resolution time.

Name: Customer satisfaction
Description: Survey responses sent after a case closes.

Name: Shared calendar
Description: Calendar and fiscal calendar dates for every domain.

Name: Sample retail data
Description: Public sample data for training and tests, with no Contoso data.

Name: Audit findings
Description: Internal audit findings with owner, due date and status.

Name: Privacy requests
Description: Data subject requests with type, due date and outcome.
